name: verify_policy
description: Verify an insurance policy and retrieve its details: status, policy type, policyholder, coverage limits, premium, deductible, and endorsements.

name: check_coverage
description: Check if a claim is covered under a policy and compute the payable amount given coverage limits, deductible, and exclusions.

claim_type.description: Type of coverage being claimed (e.g., collision, dwelling, liability)

name: get_policy_history
description: Get claims history for a policy: past claims with amounts claimed and paid, loss ratio, policy changes, and renewal recommendation.

name: search_policies
description: Search for policies by policyholder name, policy number, or claim ID. Returns matching policies with status and premium.

search_term.description: Name, policy number, or claim ID to search for
